howWeWork.label: The Process
howWeWork.heading: Simple. Transparent. Fast.
howWeWork.subtitle: No surprises, no endless back-and-forth. Here's exactly how we work.

steps.title: Tell us your idea
steps.description: Schedule a free call or send us a message. We listen, ask the right questions and tell you honestly if we're the right fit.

steps.title: We send a proposal
steps.description: Within 24 hours you get a clear proposal — scope, timeline, price. No vague estimates, no hidden fees.

steps.title: We build and keep you posted
steps.description: We start with a deposit and split payments based on project milestones — so you only pay for what's delivered. You get weekly updates and a staging environment to review progress at any time.

steps.title: Delivery + support
steps.description: We deploy, hand over the code and stay available for 30 days post-launch at no extra cost. Your software, your ownership.

about.label: About
about.heading: A developer who ships.
about.bio1: I'm Diego Correa, a full stack developer based in Medellín, Colombia. I founded Veridis Dev to build software the right way — tested, documented and production-ready from day one.
about.bio2: I work across the entire stack — from React and Next.js frontends to FastAPI and Node.js backends, PostgreSQL databases and cloud deployments on Vercel and Railway. Every project I take on gets the same attention to quality, regardless of size.
about.bio3: Currently studying Software Analysis and Development at SENA while building real products for real businesses. I believe the best way to learn is to ship.
